Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

questions.question_text:
Consider the following statements about India's defence production in 2025-26, announced by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh in June 2026:
1. It reached a record ₹1.78 lakh crore, 15.6% higher than ₹1.54 lakh crore in 2024-25.
2. It was about 110% higher than in 2020-21, when production was just over ₹84,000 crore.
3. Defence Public Sector Undertakings accounted for less than half of the total production.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

solution.explanation: Defence production rose to an all-time high of ₹1.78 lakh crore in 2025-26, up 15.6% from ₹1.54 lakh crore, and about 110% above the 2020-21 level of just over ₹84,000 crore. At the annual review of 16 DPSUs on 1 September 2026, the Raksha Mantri noted that DPSUs contributed ₹1.29 lakh crore of the roughly ₹1.8 lakh crore produced, well over half.
solution.why_others_wrong: Statement 3 is wrong: DPSUs contributed ₹1.29 lakh crore of about ₹1.8 lakh crore, i.e. well over half.

3. The new ECB staff baseline projected headline euro area inflation averaging 3.0% in 2026.

It was not the first hike of 2026: the rates had already been raised to 2.25%, 2.40% and 2.65% with effect from 17 June 2026. Staff projected inflation of 3.0% in 2026, 2.5% in 2027 and 2.1% in 2028.

Stock and index derivatives trade until 3:45 pm, and a post-closing session runs from 3:50 pm to 4:00 pm at the closing price. Most provisions apply from 7 December 2026.
